digest.component_or_area: Jira coordinator create and binding lifecycle
propositions: Create operation must execute pending-binding intent durably before any provider call; failure at this stage produces zero remote calls and item-scoped persistence failure

After Jira returns a key, the coordinator must attach the canonical rebar-id label first, treat entity property as optional enrichment, and persist through RP-02; any failure must report the known key without deleting the remote issue
Create timeout or connection loss must not trigger blind replay; observation through identity/query seams or deferred pending records must prevent duplicate creation across restart
Crash-restart and replay scenarios must converge to exactly one remote issue with one confirmed binding pair across Cloud and DC test environments
Keyed recovery must perform no search; keyless negative search requires both three consecutive misses and 3600 seconds conjunction
Other lifecycle intents must execute only after proven remote postconditions; existing tombstone, filter, read-only, hierarchy, and create-before-link rules must remain effective
